overall_assessment: Extraction is good: all 28 fetched pages hold the facts box, description, learning outcomes, teaching, assessment, requirements, prerequisites, reading list and exam overview, with the right academic year (spring offerings correctly read the previous year's page). The 20 'uncaptured' flags are false alarms: the missing lines are the year picker, exam dates, times and rooms. Remaining issues are small: a nearly empty text when a course is not taught, glued words in some pages, a run-together credit-reduction table, and a thesis code with a slash that gives a 404.

findings.evidence: Vekting 100/100 Hjelpemiddel Kode A Dato Utlevering 06.12.2018 Innlevering 12.12.2018 Varighet 5 dager Eksamenssystem Inspera Assessment
findings.description: Exam dates, times, rooms and the 'Øvrige kommentarer' notes (e.g. exam form changed because of corona) are in a second, collapsed exam block that is not captured; the text keeps only the exam form and weighting. Dates and rooms are mostly not plan content, so the loss is minor, but the corona remarks about changed assessment form are plan-relevant for 2020-2022 offerings. All 20 'uncaptured' flags come from this.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The exam detail block (dates, rooms, comments) sits outside the part of #content that the selector and block extraction keep, or is rendered by script.
findings.suggested_fix: Leave as is for dates and rooms; optionally keep the 'Øvrige kommentarer' paragraph. Add an NTNU exception to the 'uncaptured' pre-pass so that year pickers and exam date/room lines are not flagged.

findings.evidence: Det tilbys ikke lenger undervisning i emnet.
findings.description: When the page says the course is not taught (or gives no exam information), the text is a thin shell (SMF1081 has only the facts box, a subject list and an empty 'Eksamen' heading). The notice itself ('Det tilbys ikke lenger undervisning i emnet.', 'Undervises ikke studieåret 2021/2022') is dropped, so these offerings look like plans with missing content. SYT6020 and RAD6020 also end with an empty 'Eksamen' heading.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The notice sits outside the captured blocks, or is filtered as page chrome.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the not-taught notice in extracted_text, or mark offerings whose page carries it, so the frame can drop them; drop a trailing empty 'Eksamen' heading.

RAD6020 has double spaces and no line breaks in its outcomes and content. This is the page's own markup (no block separators), which hurts later section splitting.

findings.description: The 'Studiepoengreduksjon' table is tab-separated and its last row runs straight into the following prose, with no blank line; the empty 'Fra' cells leave trailing tabs. The overlap rows are course codes and credits, not plan text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Table cells are joined by tabs and the last row has no row separator.
findings.suggested_fix: Join table rows with newlines and cells with ' | ' in the block step, or exclude the Studiepoengreduksjon block and its explanation text.

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The #content block includes the portlet's title and class name as text.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the literal line 'course-details-portlet' and the 'Emne - ... - CODE' title line to the NTNU exclude/post_fn.

findings.description: The course code contains a slash and ends up as two path segments in the URL, which gives HTTP 404. NTNU's own URL for such a code may differ, so a page might exist. It is a thesis code, so impact is small.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: add_course_url builder inserts the code unchanged.
findings.suggested_fix: Check how ntnu.no links codes containing '/' (encoded slash or a different path) and encode it in the NTNU URL builder in R/add_course_url.R, or exclude thesis codes (AVHANDL) from the frame.
